# HexPiece 3.0.4

Your four Light fruit notes. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass.

- **X no longer lags.** Each slug of light that landed set off a whole explosion of light (about 1,500 shapes lasting 1.5 seconds),
  and with one slug every other tick a dozen of them were going at once. Now each slug lands in a small flash of light with its star,
  and X fires one slug every 5 ticks (about 10 in a full hold instead of 25) at a slower speed.
- **Left click is the normal punch again** with the Light fruit (the original mod's fruit mode took the click away from an empty
  hand). Not while you're travelling as light.
- **V's beam blast (when there's no one to kick) lingers** like the right-click beam's since 3.0.2.
- **V is now a kick like HexGhoul's Speed Kick.** You go as light to straight in front of them (on your side, facing them), drive a
  flying kick into their middle, and an impact frame flashes (the same one clashes use). They're sent straight away from you, low
  and very far (up to about 55 blocks at a full charge, no air drag), smashing through every block up to iron in their way (the
  holes fill themselves back in after 15 to 25 seconds, nothing drops), stopped dead (and hurt) by anything harder, and knocked down
  ragdolled where they end up. Holding V longer kicks harder and further. (Before, V came from behind their left shoulder with a
  spinning kick.)
